description: This file defines macros, structures, and inline functions for configuring and controlling GPIO pins on Atmel SAM microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: soc_gpio_configure
methods.description: Configures one or multiple GPIO pins based on provided pin configuration data.

methods.name: soc_gpio_list_configure
methods.description: Configures a list of GPIO pins with specified configurations.

methods.name: soc_gpio_get
methods.description: Reads the current value of specified GPIO pin(s).

methods.name: soc_gpio_debounce_length_set
methods.description: Sets the debounce window length for input pins.
